If more than used for rinsing is accidentally swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away.
do_not_use: Do not use in children under 12 years of age

dosage_and_administration: Directions • rinse full strength for 30 seconds with 20 mL (2/3 fluid ounce or 4 teaspoonfuls) morning and night • do not swallow
